description: S45 T3 (PM8): the audit's third state — a FAULT reading the append-only table is the typed refusal -31841, never the empty listing and never the empty-table statement. A store fault while reading the audit is neither a refusal (nothing was declined — that is the policy.read-refused code) nor an empty audit (nothing was proven absent — that answer is Count's, and it carries a sentence). Collapsing the fault into either is how "nobody has ever authored policy" gets believed beside a table full of authoring: DEF-041's rule, carried from policy_event's audit onto this one. The store's own sentence travels verbatim in what; the door wrote nothing and trimmed nothing.
